workflowDefinition.description: Chaos Commerce checkout. Prices the cart, tries a chain of ridiculous payment processors, then reserves stock and books shipping in parallel. It always ends CONFIRMED: every worker step is optional and bounded, and is followed by a server-side settle step that substitutes a safe default if the worker failed, timed out or returned nonsense.
